input:
We need manual claim routing options configurable per team.
The platform lacks the ability to configure manual claim routing options on a per-team basis.

it’s tedious to add each file one at a time. We’d really benefit from being able to upload multiple files together... uploading them one by one is slowing us down — we really need the ability to use multiple file upload to batch-add documents to a claim.
The current evidence upload process requires adding files one by one, which is inefficient for claims with many documents.

I keep getting stuck at the supplier validation step.
The user is unable to proceed past the supplier validation step when uploading supporting documents for a claim.

It’s the monthly claims reserves and payments report. Finance is questioning which figure is correct because the export doesn’t match the dashboard.
The data in the export file does not match the data shown on the dashboard for monthly claims reserves and payments.

daily frustrations with the system’s lack of live updates from garages
The system does not provide live updates from garages, causing daily frustration for the team.

the dashboard totals don’t match the export figures mismatch — I’ve re-exported three times and it’s consistent with UTC cutoff, not UK time.
The dashboard totals do not match the export figures because the system uses UTC cutoffs instead of UK time.

we’re drowning in supplier invoices and policyholder letters, and our reporting is all over the place.
The customer is overwhelmed by the volume of supplier invoices and policyholder letters, and their current reporting capabilities are inconsistent.

we need Welsh letter formats for claims and payments
The platform lacks Welsh language letter templates for claims and payments.

We need to assign clear roles and automate document routing — our current system doesn’t let us track tasks properly.
The current system lacks proper task tracking capabilities and does not support automated document routing or clear role assignment.

can we automate letters for overdue claims? I’m swamped with manual drafting.
The customer cannot automate the generation of letters for overdue claims and is forced to draft them manually.

same incident came in both by phone and through the portal, and now we’ve got two separate claims with no alert to flag it.
The system creates duplicate claims when the same incident is reported via both phone and portal, without any alert to flag the duplication.

click "Link to existing claim", dead x1
The 'Link to existing claim' button is unresponsive or broken.

we’ve been having some issues with how claims are assigned in our motor team — it’s not matching our workload or postcode zones.
The automatic claim assignment logic does not correctly account for team workload or geographic postcode zones.

we can’t see live repair updates — it’s a daily grind. We’re spending too much time calling garages because we can’t see live repair updates
The platform lacks live repair updates, forcing users to manually call garages for status checks.

I’m having trouble attaching the right files to the claim — it keeps rejecting them even though I’m sure they’re the correct format.
The system incorrectly rejects valid file attachments during the claim submission process.

Every time a garage estimate gets dumped into correspondence, someone has to manually fix it — and sometimes the wrong document category means evidence gets overlooked entirely.
The system incorrectly categorizes garage estimates as correspondence, causing evidence to be misfiled and potentially overlooked.

we’re running claims reports late into the evening and the bright interface is straining our eyes. Any chance we can get dark mode enabled?
The bright interface causes eye strain during late-night claims reporting.

Garage estimates keep landing in correspondence — we have to manually recategorise them, and sometimes evidence gets missed because of it. The incorrect file type assignment is causing real delays and oversight risks.
Garage estimates are incorrectly categorized as correspondence, forcing manual re-categorization and causing missed evidence.

Documents: click "Document type", rage x5
Documents: click "Open"
The user is frustrated by the repetitive clicking required to open documents, specifically having to click 'Document type' multiple times before being able to click 'Open'.

I’m trying to pull the latest reporting for our policyholders but I can’t access the portal. I think I’ve lost my password.
The customer is unable to access the reporting portal because they have lost their password.

we’re manually sending claim progress messages, but it’s time-consuming and inconsistent. Right now we’re manually drafting and sending claim progress messages to keep policyholders informed, but it’s inefficient and error-prone.
The platform lacks automated claim progress messaging, forcing users to manually draft and send updates which is inefficient and error-prone.

last week the Claims Tasks panel vanished without warning, and we had to retrain our team mid-week. We’d really appreciate advance notice and grouped updates.
The Claims Tasks panel disappeared unexpectedly, forcing the team to undergo mid-week retraining due to a lack of advance notice for interface changes.

We’re still waiting on the multiple file upload feature — right now I have to add each document individually, which takes ages when handling large claims with suppliers and policyholders.
The platform lacks a multiple file upload feature, forcing users to upload documents one by one.

We had unannounced screen changes last time and it caused confusion and delays because staff had to relearn where everything was — we really need advance notice and previews going forward.
Unexpected UI changes cause staff confusion and operational delays due to lack of prior notice.

garage estimates keep landing in correspondence — we have to manually recategorise them, and sometimes evidence gets missed because of it.
Garage estimates are incorrectly routed to correspondence, requiring manual recategorization and causing missed evidence.

we’ve got a couple of claims held up because the approver’s out and there’s no backup — the approval waiting list is piling up.
The platform lacks a mechanism to assign backup approvers when the primary approver is unavailable, causing claims to stall.

we’ve had three people report the same customer login outage today, and it’s holding up claims processing.
Customer login outages are preventing users from accessing the platform, which delays claims processing.

Is there a way to automate those messages?
The platform lacks an automated way to send status updates to policyholders during the claims process.

We’re still wrestling with how to track garage progress visibility without calling every supplier manually — it really breaks up our day and distracts from core claims work.
The current process for tracking garage progress requires manual calls to suppliers, which disrupts the workflow and takes time away from core claims tasks.

we really need configuration that varies by team to keep everyone happy.
The platform lacks team-specific configuration for claim routing, forcing a conflict between automated and manual workflows.

we just need a bit of warning and maybe a preview before changes go live, so we don’t waste time retraining.
The customer wants advance notice and a preview of interface changes to avoid unnecessary retraining efforts.

I’m trying to set up some saved filters on the claims list... but I can’t seem to lock them in properly.
The user is unable to successfully save or lock filters on the claims list.

the report totals differ between the dashboard and the exported file. It’s causing some trust issues.
The total values shown in the dashboard do not match the totals in the exported report file, leading to discrepancies.

we need garage progress visibility baked into the system so we don’t have to interrupt our daily work with phone calls
The system lacks built-in visibility into garage progress, forcing users to interrupt their work with phone calls.

we’re trying to pull a full report on outstanding claims and reserves but the system’s not showing updated supplier payments.
The system fails to display updated supplier payments when generating reports on outstanding claims and reserves.

Yes, I reset it yesterday and still can’t view the reserves or generate supplier payments reports. It’s blocking our weekly reporting.
The user is unable to view reserves or generate supplier payment reports even after resetting the system, which prevents them from completing their weekly reporting tasks.

our handlers are spending half their day calling garages because we can’t see live repair progress in the system.
The system does not display live repair progress, forcing handlers to manually call garages for updates.

It’s the unexpected interface changes — we keep having to retrain staff because buttons and menus shift without warning, and that’s costing us time and accuracy.
Unexpected changes to the user interface require frequent staff retraining, leading to lost time and reduced accuracy.

I need to schedule a recurring task for monthly reserves review — is that possible via the dashboard?
The customer is unsure if the dashboard supports scheduling recurring tasks for monthly reserves reviews.

Actually, I can’t log in right now — I think I need a password reset to proceed with the claims documents.
The customer is unable to access the platform due to a login failure, preventing them from uploading claims documents.

We need letters in Welsh for policyholders — it’s not just a nice-to-have, it’s tied to our renewal terms with Keelwater.
The platform currently lacks support for Welsh language letters to policyholders, which is a contractual requirement.

We’re still seeing some delays with the webhook retries on our supplier payments module, and it’s causing issues with how we process claims and update policyholders in real time.
Webhook retries on the supplier payments module are delayed, disrupting real-time claim processing and policyholder updates.

Right now, it’s one by one, which slows us down.
The current claim creation process requires uploading files individually, which is inefficient for handling bundled documents.

our motor team wants more automatic claim allocation based on postcode and workload, but commercial prefers manual control for complex cases.
The current claim allocation system does not support the motor team's need for automatic allocation based on postcode and workload, while also accommodating the commercial team's preference for manual control.

Documents: click "Document type", rage x5
Documents: click "Save"
The user is frustrated by the repetitive clicking required to select document types and save documents.

can we pull a report that shows all claims with pending letters and their associated policyholders in one view?
The user needs a consolidated report view that links pending letters to their respective policyholders.

it’s not just annoying, it’s eating into time we could spend on policyholders or tasks.
The current workflow or missing features are causing inefficiency and consuming time that should be spent on core tasks.

can we also review the roles assigned to our claims handlers? Some tasks are getting stuck in the queue.
Tasks are getting stuck in the queue, possibly due to incorrect role assignments for claims handlers.

Reports: click "Export CSV", error exception
The user encounters an error exception when attempting to export reports as CSV.

it’s been holding up payments and suppliers are starting to ask questions.
The platform is delaying payments, causing suppliers to inquire about the status.

I need to reset my password because I can’t access the claims dashboard this morning.
The user is unable to access the claims dashboard due to a password issue.

When a policyholder reports the same incident both by phone and through the web portal, the system doesn’t alert us — it just creates two separate claims...
The system fails to detect or alert users when the same incident is reported via multiple channels, resulting in duplicate claims.

we’re having trouble pulling updated reserves for our high-value claims this morning.
The user is unable to retrieve updated reserve data for high-value claims.

I’m trying to upload a claim document but the system says I’ve selected the wrong document category — can you help?
The user is unable to upload a claim document because the system incorrectly identifies the selected document category as wrong.

they’re having to upload documents one at a time still, which slows things down.
The multiple file upload feature is not functioning as intended, forcing users to upload documents individually and slowing down the workflow.

every time we need to update a policyholder or adjust reserves, we have to interrupt our workflow to phone suppliers because repair updates missing means no visibility.
The platform lacks visibility into repair updates, forcing users to interrupt their workflow and call suppliers to update policyholders or adjust reserves.

We handle a lot of late-night reserves and payments, so eye comfort matters. Let me know if there’s a timeline or workaround.
The user needs a dark mode option to reduce eye strain during late-night work.

Administration: click "Overview", dead x1
The Administration Overview page is unresponsive or broken.

we did update our supplier list last week. Could that have broken the reporting flow?
The customer suspects that updating the supplier list caused a failure in the reporting workflow.

We’re seeing some issues with how claims get assigned and docs get filed
The customer is experiencing issues with the logic for assigning claims and filing documents.

we really need claim progress messages to go out via SMS and email to policyholders automatically.
The platform does not currently support automatic SMS and email notifications for claim progress updates to policyholders.

we’ve got some handlers still manually moving garage estimates out of correspondence, and it’s causing delays.
Handlers are manually moving garage estimates out of correspondence, which causes delays.

can we adjust the reserves on policyholder claims without triggering alerts?
The user wants to modify reserves on policyholder claims without the system automatically generating alerts.

We’ve been trying to use the bulk upload function since the update, but it’s still not handling upload files together reliably — we get timeouts on batches over 50 documents.
The bulk upload function fails with timeouts when processing batches larger than 50 documents.
